comments.author: @RaffGoodman
comments.text:
Believe it or not, salt is salt. But the very idea of ​​a sovereign state or country can be destroyed if some people stop believing in it.

I mean... dude, social and political studies are exist you know? A country is just as objective phenomenon as salt. You can’t simply declare "I don’t believe in the USA" and make it vanish. You can’t say, "I don’t believe in EU sovereignty," and cause it to disappear. No one can do that. And if the EU isn’t considered a country (though it is, but some can argue), it certainly isn’t because some people don’t believe in it.

replies.author: @RaffGoodman
replies.text: Oh, and Scotland isn't a country. It's just named as a country in UK. As well as Swiss confederation is not a confederation. Switzerland is a federal state having a fancy historical name.
